title: R2 sync omitted mdp_policy.npz: a host restored from R2 (the Fly instance, 4/10) silently ran the heuristic instead of the MDP policy
tier_reason: restore coverage: a restore from the R2 bundle produced a host that decided with a different policy and said nothing; the same class recurs for the tail artifact (residual)

contract.text: Every artifact the live decision path loads is in the R2 restore bundle, so a restored host decides with the same policy as production.
contract.source: src/bts/data/sync.py sync_to_r2 (947fce8); CLAUDE.md 'MDP-optimal strategy: auto-loads data/models/mdp_policy.npz'

mechanism.text: sync_to_r2 uploaded the processed data but not data/models/mdp_policy.npz, so a host bootstrapped from R2 found no policy file and the strategy fell back to the heuristic without an alert

residual.text: sync_to_r2 still ships only mdp_policy.npz, not data/models/mdp_tail_policy.npz (added 9/03): a tail-regime host restored from R2 alone runs the forced fallback action (recorded as degraded_reason, not silent). Both artifacts are also force-tracked in git.

watchdog.trigger: a restore drill (or R2 manifest check) finds a model/policy artifact that the live decision path loads missing from the bundle, or a restored host whose decision records carry a degraded or heuristic source
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the restored host's decision records show the same policy sha and objective as production with no degraded_reason

evidence.what: reported contemporaneous fallback on Fly: 947fce8's body says the R2-restored Fly host lacked mdp_policy.npz and the strategy fell back to the heuristic (the restore log itself is not retained)

notes: split from E106 per Codex phase-1 r3 answer 7: the same commit fixed a restore-coverage defect with its own mechanism
deployed unknown: the fix's candidate run executed the Fly deploy.yml; production (Pi5) has no install record before the 4/11 cutover
fixtures: filled from Task 5/6 acceptance objects at build time

observed on the Fly shadow host (the 2nd bot of I-017), a real restore from R2: the design's scope covers restore dependencies on any host (§2), so the restore contract's deviation is an observed incident; whether any public Fly pick was decided by the heuristic is not evidenced

evidence strength (Codex phase-1 r4 ruling): reported contemporaneous fallback on Fly; the R2 omission (sync_to_r2 at 947fce8^) and the bootstrap path (scripts/fly-bootstrap.sh runs sync-from-r2 for the model directory on an empty volume) are verified in code. Not established: an exact outage start, a witnessed contest pick, a verified repair, or any production impact.
